name: Withered Promised
source:
🌹Withered Promised is a romantic and somewhat dark visual novel where a promise made in a mysterious garden can change everything. Some people tell stories and legends that say flowers listen. Others, however, claim they demand something in return.

You start to feel different, and him? He begins to fade away...

Could it be just a coincidence?

[Translated from [url=https://katwhite4.itch.io/withered-promised]Itch.io[/url]]
